composition.engine: v32-composed authenticated v30/v19 Boolean-master and replay runtime
composition.scope: exact n=15, ordinary first-interior fresh arm, endpoint cross-hit plus shared blocker

role_map.kept: Q.C and the first endpoint common-shell source
role_map.deleted: the middle point in the ordinary v8 fresh walk
role_map.fresh: Q.K and the endpoint-collision source, still in the first strict cap interior
role_map.J: one-hot over carrier labels outside the first strict cap interior
role_map.common: the dynamic critical row selected by blocker(kept)
role_map.qrow: Q.row, an exact selected four-subset of rich[0,0]
role_map.seed: common union qrow, exactly six points
role_map.qsel: one simultaneous selected four-class choice at every active seed center

endpoint_shared_blocker_constraints.j_cross_hit: J[j] implies fresh belongs to dynamicRow(j)
endpoint_shared_blocker_constraints.qrow: exactly four, subset rich[0,0], contains kept and J
endpoint_shared_blocker_constraints.seed: common union qrow has cardinality six
endpoint_shared_blocker_constraints.selected_rows: qsel[c] is an exact four-subset of k4[c] exactly when c is in seed
endpoint_shared_blocker_constraints.escape: some active qsel[c] contains a point outside seed

selected_support_guard.reason: selected four-subsets need not be full physical radius classes

runtime_binding.v12_v16: schema paths, Encoding, source contract, and provenance rebound to v33
runtime_binding.v19: schema paths, source contract, provenance, and frozen-provenance verifier rebound to v33
runtime_binding.v30: profile-specific semantic Boolean counter rebound to the v33 formula
runtime_binding.tracker_allowlist: inherits v32 and adds every v33 endpoint-seed constraint family
runtime_binding.restoration: all mutable module globals restored after normal or exceptional exit

spawn_contract.child_attestation: exact v33 provenance, encoding identity, engine identity, PID, and spawn method
spawn_contract.parent_gate: case identity, frozen provenance, exact Boolean count, family counts, journal, terminal policy, and durable bytes

terminal_status.unknown_policy: fail closed; no blocker is admitted without replay-authenticated UNSAT

trust_boundary: external exact-n15 shared-blocker-slice evidence; not finite coverage, Lean closure, or a universal E1 proof
